title: Digital Skills & Online Teaching Masterclass
tagline: From digital confidence to a professional online teaching offer in 5 weeks.
desc: A 5-week practical programme designed to take participants from basic digital confidence to online teaching, curriculum and course design, digital content creation, and professional positioning. Participants learn how to use essential digital and AI tools, teach effectively online, design a curriculum or course, create digital learning resources, and develop a professional portfolio and knowledge-based offer.
format: Self-Paced Lessons + Weekly Live Coaching & Q&A

lessons.title: Getting comfortable with the digital toolbox
content: Build the everyday digital confidence every modern educator and trainer needs, from files and folders to collaboration and communication tools.

lessons.title: Practical AI for educators
content: Learn the essential AI tools and prompt skills that save hours of preparation time while keeping your teaching original and responsible.

lessons.title: Deliver a short online teaching sample
content: Plan, record and deliver a short online teaching sample that demonstrates your ability to teach clearly and engagingly online.

lessons.title: Design a curriculum, course or training outline
content: Structure your knowledge into a curriculum/course/training outline with clear learning outcomes and a simple launch plan.

title: Instructional Design Fundamentals
tagline: Foundations of learning science and outcome-first course design.
desc: Learn the foundations of learning science, ADDIE, Bloom's taxonomy, and how to structure engaging learning pathways that produce measurable outcomes.

lessons.title: Foundations of learning science
content: Explore how adults learn and the learning theory that underpins effective course design.

lessons.title: Conducting practical needs assessments
content: Gather the learner data you need to design training that solves real performance problems.

lessons.title: Writing measurable learning outcomes
content: Write clear, measurable learning outcomes using Bloom's Revised Taxonomy.

lessons.title: Module structure, lesson plans and formative evaluation
content: Structure course modules, lesson plans and formative evaluations that flow logically and build mastery.

title: AI for Educators
tagline: Save preparation hours and personalise support with generative AI.

lessons.title: Core principles of prompt engineering

lessons.title: Lesson plans, rubrics and quiz generation
content: Automate lesson planning, rubrics and quiz generation with proven AI workflows.

lessons.title: AI tools for differentiated learning

lessons.title: Academic integrity and AI policy guidelines
